title: Lake Urmia Islands Welcome Birds Once Again
text:
Lake Urmia Islands Welcome Birds Once Again"

"The islands of Lake Urmia in northwestern Iran have once again become hosts to migratory birds. This marks a hopeful ecological revival for the lake, which had dramatically shrunk over the past two decades due to severe drought, dam construction, and water diversion—losing nearly 90% of its surface area at its worst point."

"However, increased rainfall over recent years, combined with water release projects, has raised the lake's water levels and reduced its salinity, allowing its islands to transform back into safe nesting and resting grounds. The returning flocks include species such as flamingos, pelicans, and various migratory waterfowl, signaling a partial but significant recovery for this UNESCO-listed biosphere reserve. "

"🎦 Video footage shows the vibrant return of these bird populations to the region.
